episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: At a club, Mat is dragged into a brawl and his life alters forever when he accidentally kills a man. Years later, happiness finally seems within reach.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While investigating the alleged suicide of a nun at the Catholic orphanage where she grew up, Lorena discovers the nun is not who she'd said she was.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Mat enlists Zoe, a private investigator, to help him track down Olivia. Lorena tries to figure out how Mat fits into the death of the mysterious nun.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The nun's body is squirreled away by federal agents, which infuriates Lorena. Zoe tracks down Olivia's location, and she and Mat rush to find her.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Federal agents try to push Lorena out of the case. Meanwhile, Olivia makes a confession that leaves Mat reeling.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: When federal agents arrest Olivia, they take her home instead of to jail so that Teo, the lead inspector, can negotiate a deal. Mat runs to Marbella.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Olivia is reunited with an old friend. Out of frustration, Lorena quits the force but is lured back with a promise of free rein.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Kimmy gives Olivia the info she needs. Mat thinks he's free until new charges come up against him and he realizes who's been after him all along.
